Here are student-friendly picks:

1. **Online grammar quiz (around Grade 5)** — [**5th Grade English Quiz: Test Your Grammar Skills**](https://www.proprofs.com/quiz-school/story.php?title=mjgyoda4naugdk) — ProProfs
   * A short **10-question**, multiple-choice quiz listed for **Grades 4–6**. It practices approachable topics including past tense, synonyms, correct sentences, nouns, proper nouns, adverbs, plurals, adjectives, and homophones. This is a good quick warm-up with readable question-and-answer choices.

2. **Printable basic-marketing activity (Grade 8)** — [**The 4 P’s of Marketing: Exit Ticket and Product Matrix**](https://brightsprout.com/worksheet/the-4-ps-of-marketing-exit-ticket-and-product-matrix) — BrightSprout
   * This is specifically labeled for **8th Grade**. Students answer three exit-ticket questions, then make a marketing matrix for a product they choose, using **product, price, place, and promotion**. The page says it can be printed as-is or customized before downloading—nice for an easy-to-read classwork or homework sheet.

3. **Slidesgo template for both activities** — [**Creative Colorful Worksheets for Middle School Presentation**](https://slidesgo.com/theme/creative-colorful-worksheets-for-middle-school)
   * A **free**, colorful, editable **A4 printable** template with activities and abstract people illustrations. It is flexible enough to use one slide/page for the grammar-quiz directions and another for a 4 Ps product matrix; you can replace the included grammar exercises with marketing prompts. It is also marked for middle school and printable, so it should feel more age-appropriate for the marketing activity while still being friendly for the grammar warm-up.
